fields.title: CAPSULES
fields.description: Solid dosage form in which the drug is enclosed in a hard or soft soluble container or shell of gelatin.

fields.title: TABLETS
fields.description: Solid pharmaceutical dosage form containing drug substances with or without suitable diluents, prepared by compression.

fields.title: INJECTION SOLUTION
fields.description: Sterile liquid preparation containing one or more soluble drug substances dissolved in a suitable vehicle for parenteral administration.

fields.title: ORAL SUSPENSION
fields.description: Liquid preparation containing finely divided drug particles distributed somewhat uniformly throughout a vehicle in which the drug exhibits minimum solubility.

fields.title: CREAM
fields.description: Semisolid emulsion dosage form containing one or more drug substances dissolved or dispersed in a suitable base, usually for external skin application.

fields.title: OINTMENT
fields.description: Semisolid preparation intended for external application to the skin or mucous membranes, typically utilizing an anhydrous, greasy base.

fields.title: ORAL SYRUP
fields.description: Concentrated aqueous solution of a sugar, such as sucrose, containing a medicinal agent for pleasant tasting oral intake.

fields.title: POWDER FOR RECONSTITUTION
fields.description: Mixture of dry, finely divided drugs and excipients requiring the addition of a specified liquid vehicle before administration (e.g., antibiotics).

fields.title: TRANSDERMAL PATCH
fields.description: Medicated adhesive patch placed on the skin to deliver a specific, controlled dose of medication through the skin and into the bloodstream.

fields.title: GEL
fields.description: Semisolid system consisting of either suspensions made up of small inorganic particles or large organic molecules interpenetrated by a liquid.

fields.title: EYE DROPS
fields.description: Sterile aqueous or oily solutions or suspensions of one or more active pharmaceutical ingredients intended for instillation into the conjunctival sac.

fields.title: SUPPOSITORY
fields.description: Solid dosage form intended for insertion into body orifices (rectum, vagina, or urethra) where it melts, softens, or dissolves to exert localized or systemic effects.

fields.title: INHALER AEROSOL
fields.description: Pharmaceutical product packaged under pressure containing therapeutic active ingredients released upon activation of an appropriate valve system.

fields.title: INTRAUTERINE DEVICE
fields.description: Specialized drug-delivery system inserted into the uterine cavity designed to continuously release active agents (e.g., hormones) over an extended timeframe.

fields.title: LYOPHILIZED POWDER VIAL
fields.description: Freeze-dried sterile drug matrix requiring reconstitution with a specific diluent right before parenteral injection, optimized for unstable macromolecules.

fields.title: LIPOSOMAL SUSPENSION
fields.description: Advanced lipid-bilayer vesicular nanoparticle formulation designed to encapsulate active molecules, targeting specific tissues while reducing systemic toxicity.

fields.title: ORALLY DISINTEGRATING TABLET
fields.description: Solid oral formulation engineered to dissolve rapidly on the tongue without the need for water, optimizing compliance for pediatric or dysphagic patients.

fields.title: EXTENDED RELEASE CAPSULE
fields.description: Sustained-release oral capsule containing coated matrix beads designed to slowly discharge active ingredients to maintain consistent therapeutic blood levels.

fields.title: EXTEMPORANEOUS PASTE
fields.description: Thick, stiff semisolid preparation containing a high concentration of finely divided solids dispersed in an oily or aqueous vehicle for localized structural protection.

fields.title: SOLU CONTAINED FILM
fields.description: Thin, flexible polymeric strip placed directly in the buccal cavity or on the tongue to disintegrate rapidly for systemic mucosal tracking.

fields.title: MEDICATED SHAMPOO
fields.description: Liquid surfactant vehicle containing active antifungal, cytostatic, or anti-keratolytic substances designed for localized treatment of scalp and skin pathologies.

fields.title: SUBCUTANEOUS IMPLANT ROD
fields.description: Biocompatible, non-erodible rod system inserted subdermally to deliver long-term, zero-order release kinetics of active hormones over several years.

fields.title: LOTION
fields.description: Low-to-medium viscosity fluid emulsion intended for external application to unbroken cutaneous skin layers without causing friction.

fields.title: EFFERVESCENT TABLET
fields.description: Uncoated tablet containing organic acids and sodium bicarbonate engineered to react rapidly in water, releasing carbon dioxide to form a buffered solution.
